text: Wahoo Fitness, the Atlanta connected-fitness company, fully recapitalised and eliminated all debt in 2023 under the leadership of company founder Chip Hawkins, with 'equal' new and existing investors (SGI Europe names Rhône Group and David Wichmann of Jory Capital & Human Powered Health among them).
short: Wahoo Fitness was recapitalised in 2023 under founder Chip Hawkins with 'equal' investors including Rhône Group.

source.name: SGI Europe: 'Wahoo founder buys fitness company back from banks' (Wolfgang Greiner)
source.quote: Wahoo Fitness has fully recapitalized its company and eliminated all debt under the leadership of company founder Chip Hawkins and “equal” investors
